# ABC News

> > ABC News delivers breaking news, live coverage, and in-depth analysis across politics, business, health, international affairs, and U.S. national stories.

ABC News is a comprehensive news platform offering 24/7 live streaming, video archives, and coverage of major news categories including politics, business, health, and international events. The site serves as a primary source for breaking news updates and detailed reporting on current events.

## Breaking News & Live Coverage

- [ABC News - Breaking News, Latest News and Videos](https://abcnews.com): ABC News homepage with breaking news, analysis, and latest headlines

- [ABC News Videos - ABC News](https://abcnews.com/Video): Video archive and news segments covering breaking news and top stories
